correctness.rationale: For all admissible allocations the quadratic form of M is the sum of the baseline, path edge energies, and nonnegative coordinate penalties. With v=0 a vector in the null space would be constant, then vanish because some x_i>0. Thus M is positive definite and a unique steady state exists. The (1,3) cofactor is k², so c₃=qk²/det M with a positive denominator. Set a=v+k and b=v+2k. The determinant is (a+x₁)(b+x₂)(a+x₃)−k²(2a+x₁+x₃). With x₂ fixed it increases strictly under endpoint balancing except at equality, giving x=(u,F−2u,u). Along that line D′/2=g(u)=(a+u)(F+k−3u)−k². Independently of the logdet argument, g is a quadratic with negative leading coefficient and g(0)=aF+kv>0, so it has exactly one positive root with a sign change. At F/2 its derivative criterion is D′(F/2)=(4kv−2vF−F²)/2, giving the stated threshold including the endpoint optimum at equality. Above it the positive quadratic root lies strictly within the interval and is the displayed radical; g(u)=0 forces F−3u=k²/(a+u)−k<0. Hence F/3<u<F/2 and 0<x₂<u. At v=0 the threshold is zero and all positive budgets are interior. The two-room inverse entry has a positive constant numerator k and a denominator uniquely maximized at equal splitting; an intermediate room first exists on a three-vertex path. For k=1,v=1/2,F=2, direct substitution gives u≈0.8586778913 and c₃≈0.09290658561 for q=1. The supplied verifier and verification note were inspected, not executed. This is the stated continuous-budget steady receptor model, not transient exposure, arbitrary graphs or a field validation.

value.rationale: The receptor placement and continuously divisible air-cleaning budget give a natural design question before any algebra. The exact transition gives an actionable distinction within the ideal model: a positive background sink creates an interval of budgets at which the only connecting room is optimally left unfunded, whereas no such interval exists when the sink is zero. The solution gives both the threshold and actual unique rates, not only generic convexity or a small numerical witness. This is a deliberately minimal path classification, not a claim of practical performance in uncontrolled buildings.
